src/domains/blossom.ts.name: Blossom file hosting mock
src/domains/blossom.ts.description: Stores files by checksum on a seeded server list and answers check, get, upload, mirror, media, list, delete and server-list changes.

src/domains/file-bytes.ts.name: File byte helpers
src/domains/file-bytes.ts.description: Base64, hex and placeholder-byte helpers shared by the resource, upload, Blossom, Hashtree, file system and Git mocks.

src/domains/fs.ts.name: File system mock
src/domains/fs.ts.description: A virtual file system with roots, pickers, read, write, folders, move, remove and change watching, within configurable limits.

src/domains/git-fixtures.ts.name: Git sample repository
src/domains/git-fixtures.ts.description: An in-memory Git object model with real SHA-1 ids, plus the seeded distro-notes repository.

src/domains/git.ts.name: Git mock
src/domains/git.ts.description: Opens a seeded repository and answers refs, object reads, new commits, ref updates, fetch, push and proposals, returning receipts.

src/domains/hashtree-fixtures.ts.name: Hashtree sample tree
src/domains/hashtree-fixtures.ts.description: Builds the seeded Hashtree document tree and its identifiers, with a self-contained bech32 encoder shared with the resource mock.

src/domains/hashtree.ts.name: Hashtree mock
src/domains/hashtree.ts.description: A seeded content tree with resolve, list, read, put, publish, pick, import, export and pin requests, tracking import and export jobs.

src/domains/resource.ts.name: Fetched resources mock
src/domains/resource.ts.description: Resolves resource addresses to bytes and a sniffed type, or a typed failure, answering info, single and batch fetch and cancel.

src/domains/storage.ts.name: Saved data store
src/domains/storage.ts.description: An in-memory store for napplet saved data, which the runtime itself serves; adds controls to inspect it and counts sizes in bytes.

src/domains/upload.ts.name: Upload mock
src/domains/upload.ts.description: Accepts uploads over Blossom and NIP-96, tracks each one to completion, and pushes status changes with a placeholder image preview hash.
